exercises.instruction: FILL IN THE GAPS TO WRITE EACH SENTENCE THREE DIFFERENT WAYS

items.question: She wants to have a cat.
items.correct_answer: She would like to have a cat. / She'd like to have a cat.

items.question: They would like to visit Tokyo. / They'd like to visit Tokyo.
items.correct_answer: They want to visit Tokyo. / They'd like to visit Tokyo.

items.question: I want to eat an orange. / I would like to eat an orange.
items.correct_answer: I want to eat an orange. / I would like to eat an orange.

items.question: You want to learn Spanish. / You'd like to learn Spanish.
items.correct_answer: You want to learn Spanish. / You'd like to learn Spanish.

items.question: We want to go to a café. / We would like to go to a café.
items.correct_answer: We want to go to a café. / We would like to go to a café.

items.question: He would like to live in Germany. / He'd like to live in Germany.
items.correct_answer: He would like to live in Germany. / He'd like to live in Germany.

items.question: We want to swim in a lake. / We'd like to swim in a lake.
items.correct_answer: We want to swim in a lake. / We'd like to swim in a lake.

exercises.instruction: MATCH THE PICTURES TO THE CORRECT SENTENCES

items.question: Picture 1 (Sailing)
items.correct_answer: They'd like to go sailing on a sailboat.

items.question: Picture 2 (Statue of Liberty)
items.correct_answer: Dan would like to travel to New York.

items.question: Picture 3 (Reading)
items.correct_answer: Sharon wants to read her book.

items.question: Picture 4 (Mountain climbing)
items.correct_answer: Doug would like to climb a mountain.

items.question: Picture 5 (Beach/Tahiti)
items.correct_answer: We want to go on vacation to Tahiti.
